reply: Thank you for explaining that authorization holds on your purchases are higher than the final charges, and that the difference is not being returned to your available balance. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep a list of each purchase with the hold amount and final charge, and ask in writing for each remaining hold to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have tried for weeks to activate your card, spending hours on hold and sending your identification several times, while you cannot access your pay. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the prepaid card team. Please keep the dates of your calls and submissions, and ask in writing what is still needed to release your funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the latest response about your prepaid card balance still does not address the accounting points you raised. We understand your frustration after an earlier error was acknowledged. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team, including your summary of the discrepancies. Please keep both responses and your transaction records, and ask in writing for a full ledger of the account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that six fraudulent transactions were made on your stolen card within two hours, and that your claim has been denied four times despite a police report and video. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for the reasons for the decision and the documents used, and keep all your evidence. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that unemployment claims were filed in several states using your Social Security number without your knowledge. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please report the identity theft, keep your affidavit and tax transcripts, and contact each state's unemployment agency to report the claims. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one of your gift cards cannot be activated because it has expired, and that the merchant and distributor each refer you to the other. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card, the order confirmation and your messages, and ask in writing whether the funds can be restored or a replacement issued. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $3,100.00 dispute filed in 2021 is still unresolved, even though you have sent every document requested. We understand your frustration after so long. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your claim number and copies of what you sent, and ask in writing for the current status and a date for a decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that some of your stolen funds were returned, but a merchant credit went to your cancelled card and cannot be moved to your replacement card. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the merchant's credit confirmation, and ask in writing how the credit and the escalated charges will be handled. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the gift card from your employer has part of its number scratched off and a magnetic strip that does not work. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card and any details from your employer about the purchase, and ask in writing how a replacement can be issued. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you still cannot access the funds on your prepaid gift card after faxing your information, and that the fax number was not working. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the fax confirmations and the earlier response letter, and ask in writing for confirmation that your documents were received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $100.00 rebate card was stolen and used, and that you have not received the replacement card or the refund you were told about. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Please keep the date you reported the theft and any reference numbers, and ask in writing for the status of the replacement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $100.00 birthday gift card could not be activated because the card number was not fully shown and appeared tampered with. We understand your disappointment. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card and its packaging, and ask the giver for the purchase receipt if possible, so a replacement can be requested. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have spent hours trying to get a gift card refunded, and that calls keep dropping and messages are not returned. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please send your refund request in writing to the address on the letter you received, with the card details, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
